notes.title: Confluence in VN Fest 2025!
notes.content:
We're delighted to say that [i]Confluence[/i] is in its first ever VN Fest alongside the game it accompanies, [i]Of Sense and Soul![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329116/453743e25d9eab32daaf8df683539e4d365781e1.jpg[/img]

[i]Of Sense and Soul[/i] is where it all starts for our favourite bookish boy — all that sappiness and contentment he feels in Confluence comes from his journey of self-discovery in OSAS!

You can play the demo today, or check out voiced scenes from the game all week on our broadcast there.

(And, of course, giving the game a [b]wishlist[/b] would be a great help to us if you'd like to follow along!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2231680/Of_Sense_and_Soul/

Happy VN Fest, and happy gaming!
